en-US.description: CLI for interacting with Rekor, Sigstore's signature transparency log
en-US.longDescription: Rekor is a cryptographically secure, immutable append-only log of signatures. The rekor CLI records signed metadata to the transparency log, verifies entries and inclusion proofs, and retrieves entries by public key or artifact.
en-US.name: rekor-cli
en-US.releaseNotes:
Changelog
This release is built with Go 1.27.3 and updates the PGP dependency to no longer use the unmaintained x/crypto package.
- 206912e3cf61ba3fed587896e10d4812411e6913 build releases w/ go 1.27.3 toolchain on golang-cross v1.27.2-0 (#3029)
- 8ae33bde942047f3f8003a01625c577687c605d9 Replace cyberphone/json-canonicalization with encoding/json/jsontext (#3028)
- 6da522bd9133aae992a1a725baeb4b093e447a1a Replace hashicorp/go-retryablehttp with std lib retry transport (#2933)
- 2192dfbb5633472a97c1a8a33bb9167767fc0e32 re-implement pgp v3 signature support (#3018)
- b7e5e99f66562fbbbba531303efe8f7278e14c17 feat: serve the API over TLS with a configurable TLS policy (#2920)
- 37d393838e056aa397aa308ceda6f8b6498dcd30 fix broken sigv3 parsing, add tests (#2959)
- d8bd80452e41ae5be1d792f391531ff742e8246b dsse parsing cpu/memory optimization (#2946)
- db458f0eefd738dd4dfd0df8b451142b345716a3 ensure invalid treeIDs always return with 400 errors (#2958)
- 9651c3f007a7afdd45f380b837f34d2e47f6b4f0 use WithCancel ctx for async tasks (#2947)
- eee7d8d644f5713e3c1ace419425aa3ceadc46d7 Update 413 status code error handling (#2813)
Thanks for all contributors!

zh-CN.description: 与 Rekor（Sigstore 签名透明日志）交互的命令行工具
zh-CN.longDescription: Rekor 是一个密码学安全的、仅追加的签名透明日志。rekor 命令行工具可将签名元数据记录到透明日志中，验证日志条目和包含证明，并支持按公钥或工件检索条目。
